### Goal
Fix the dunning email scheduler so it does not send reminders to already-paid customers. Router splitting is paused. Later, complete `rename_get_user_record` and continue router extraction.

### Constraints and rules
Do not increase SQLAlchemy pool size; staging deadlocks. Use `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev`; `sbx-pay-a` is shut down and serves stale fixtures. Run `make license-check` from repo root after changing `requirements/base.txt`. Paste exact test output next time rather than paraphrasing.

### Key decisions and facts
`get_user_record` was renamed to `fetch_account`; procedure steps 1–4 are complete. Decimal/`ROUND_HALF_UP` rounding is established. Pending events are removed only after successful charging and persistence; batches are copied. `_last_batch` was removed. CLI billing filters now use shared helpers; abbreviated options remain supported.

### Ruled out
SQLAlchemy pool enlargement; unrelated invoice-rounding changes; router work until the dunning bug is fixed.

### Progress
Worker suite: 41 passed. Repro peak 7.3 MiB, settled 2.1 MiB, pending 0. Full suite: 118 passed, 7 skipped. CLI/command tests: 37 passed. Ruff and `git diff --check` pass. Added currency abbreviation regression.

### Next steps
Inspect `ledgerly/dunning/scheduler.py` and payment/account status data flow; add a paid-customer regression test, implement the fix, and run focused tests with exact output.
